summary.quota_rule: QUALIFIES may count as a genuinely decisive first experiment below $100,000 because failure kills a load-bearing company premise with objective thresholds. CONDITIONAL counts only after every listed signed access, data, facility, or customer prerequisite is evidenced. DOES_NOT_QUALIFY has no honest decisive design below $100,000.
summary.important_limit: Classification concerns experiment decisiveness and cash budget, not whether the idea passes P5 gates or belongs in the final portfolio. No customer, partner, facility, data access, or in-kind contribution is claimed to exist.
summary.ranking_basis: Confidence that the proposed experiment is company-decisive, objectively pre-registrable, and honestly budgeted; not P4 score.
